title: Yellowed Crispy Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A sweet and comforting Mediterranean dish featuring ground pistachios and crispy lamb, cooked to perfection in an agave leaf vessel, halal friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, ground pistachios, olive oil, onion, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Lay an agave leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 of the lamb mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package, repeating with the remaining lamb mixture and agave leaves.
Place the packages in a large baking dish, leaving a little space between each package to allow for even cooking.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the agave leaves are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the packages from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
